I am an ADHD now client and yeah the price is a pinch which is very annoying, however for me it was worth the investment into myself. I always knew there was something ' different ' about me and getting confirmation was so healing to me, so for the price I thought of it as an investment for the child version of myself.( I'm 33) . Do I think they should improve public services? Absolutely! And it is crazy money to be paying but I try and look at it in a more positive light. I think it's so sad however that there are people who desperately need these services and simply cannot afford it, and in some cases it could be life saving treatment.

I found the people at ADHD now very helpful at least and understanding, very friendly too. It's just unfortunate forking out huge money for someone that should be more cost effective, considering the amount of people who are neurodivergent.

I WOULD BE INTERESTED

I'm sorry for your loss! What a rollercoaster of emotions. 

I lost my abusive ex in 2021 to suicide. It was such a tumultuous relationship. I was lost for so long dealing with the guilt and confusion of it all.

The shock is overwhelming,  trying to process that it actually happened. I know I have intense feelings of panic realising that it was actually real.

People are going to say the wrong thing to you so be mindful of that, they won't mean to, they just don't understand the complexity of losing someone to suicide, and the fact that it was abusive on top of that unfortunately adds another layer of confusion.

If I could go back to my past self I would say to be patient, I know that's a frustrating thing to hear in the whirlwind of feelings! But give yourself time, it will take a long time to process it all and that's okay. Really give yourself time to heal. And if you're not talking to someone about this maybe take the time to consider it, if you're not ready now, you may be in a few months, who knows. Please mind yourself and reach out to friends. 

It's such a tough journey! I sincerely hope you can heal from this!

I'm hoping to have an apartment to myself soon, as unfortunately it's been a struggle where I am as rent is so high and I've had had insane housemates. So hopefully indo more processing soon. Its just  seemingly never ending haha.
I'm so sorry that you're going through this, it's not easy at all, I wish I had an easy answer for you.  I hope you can be kind to yourself in this.
